title: Treaty of Hamburg (1762)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Treaty of Hamburg (1762)", at revision 1352218213, opens: "The Treaty of Hamburg was signed on 22 May 1762 in Hamburg between Sweden and Prussia during the Pomeranian War, a theater of the Seven Years' War." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q521923, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Treaty that ended the Pomeranian War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
